calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Connect your Microsoft calendar so your AI can check your real availability and write appointments and callbacks straight to it.

errors.stateExpired: The connection request expired. Please try connecting again.
errors.providerError: Microsoft couldn't complete the connection. Please try again.

card.notConnected: No calendar is connected yet. Connecting lets your AI offer your real availability and add appointments and callbacks straight to your calendar.
card.connectedAs: Connected as {email}. Your appointments and callbacks sync to this calendar.
card.connectedNoEmail: Your Microsoft calendar is connected — appointments and callbacks sync to it.
card.reconnectFallback: The connection stopped working. Reconnect to resume availability checks and syncing appointments and callbacks.
card.disconnectDescription: Your AI will stop checking this calendar for availability, and new appointments and callbacks won't be added to it. You can reconnect at any time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Who on your team hears about what your AI assistant captures. Turn routing on for a notification and an assistant picks the recipients from your rules and their roles; off, each goes to its usual default.
notifications.noModules: None of the modules that send team notifications (leads, jobs, quotes, callbacks) are enabled for this business.

newLead.title: New lead
newLead.description: Sent when your AI assistant logs a lead on a call. Leads you add in the portal never trigger it.
newLead.enabledDescription: When off, it goes to the lead's assignee, or the business owner when nobody is assigned. Your recipients and rules are kept for when you turn it back on.
newLead.recipientsDescription: The people the assistant can choose from. It picks who actually gets each lead from your rules and their roles — usually one person, not everyone.
newLead.rulesDescription: Plain-English instructions for which leads go to whom, and which should go to nobody.
newLead.rulesEmpty: No rules yet — the assistant will go by each person's role to decide who should get each lead. Add rules to tell it how to route them.
newLead.testNobody: The assistant would have sent that lead to nobody.

rulePlaceholders.first: Any appraisal or sales enquiry goes to bill@example.com
rulePlaceholders.second: Rental enquiries go to the property manager
rulePlaceholders.third: Don't email anyone about tenants asking for a rent receipt

newJob.title: New job
newJob.description: Sent when your AI assistant logs or books a job on a call. Jobs you add in the portal never trigger it.
newJob.enabledDescription: When off, it goes to the job's assignee, or the business owner when nobody is assigned. Your recipients and rules are kept for when you turn it back on.
newJob.recipientsDescription: The people the assistant can choose from. It picks who actually gets each job from your rules and their roles — usually one person, not everyone.
newJob.rulesDescription: Plain-English instructions for which jobs go to whom, and which should go to nobody.
newJob.rulesEmpty: No rules yet — the assistant will go by each person's role to decide who should get each job. Add rules to tell it how to route them.
newJob.testNobody: The assistant would have sent that job to nobody.

rulePlaceholders.first: Plumbing jobs go to mick@example.com, electrical to dave@example.com
rulePlaceholders.second: Anything marked urgent also goes to the office
rulePlaceholders.third: Jobs in the northern suburbs go to the north team

newQuoteRequest.title: New quote request
newQuoteRequest.description: Sent when your AI assistant logs a quote request on a call, so it gets priced up. Quotes you create in the portal never trigger it.
newQuoteRequest.enabledDescription: When off, it goes to the business owner. Your recipients and rules are kept for when you turn it back on.
newQuoteRequest.recipientsDescription: The people the assistant can choose from. It picks who actually gets each quote request from your rules and their roles — usually one person, not everyone.
newQuoteRequest.rulesDescription: Plain-English instructions for which quote requests go to whom, and which should go to nobody.
newQuoteRequest.rulesEmpty: No rules yet — the assistant will go by each person's role to decide who should get each quote request. Add rules to tell it how to route them.
newQuoteRequest.testLabel: Test with the latest quote request
newQuoteRequest.testNobody: The assistant would have sent that quote request to nobody.

rulePlaceholders.second: Anything under $500 goes to the office, larger jobs to the owner
rulePlaceholders.third: Quotes for existing customers go to their account manager

teamCallbackReminder.title: Team callback reminder
teamCallbackReminder.description: Sent shortly before a callback that someone on your team promised to make, so it isn't missed.
teamCallbackReminder.enabledDescription: When off, it goes to the team member the callback is assigned to. Your recipients and rules are kept for when you turn it back on.
teamCallbackReminder.recipientsDescription: The people the assistant can choose from. It picks who actually gets each callback from your rules and their roles — usually one person, not everyone.
teamCallbackReminder.rulesDescription: Plain-English instructions for which callbacks go to whom, and which should go to nobody.
teamCallbackReminder.rulesEmpty: No rules yet — the assistant will go by each person's role to decide who should get each callback. Add rules to tell it how to route them.
teamCallbackReminder.testNobody: The assistant would have sent that callback to nobody.

rulePlaceholders.first: Callbacks about rentals go to the property manager, not the owner
rulePlaceholders.second: If the caller asked for a specific person, remind that person
rulePlaceholders.third: Send every reminder to the office inbox as well

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Your plan, usage and payment details.
billing.descriptionMember: Manage your subscription and payment details.

notAvailable.title: Not available
notAvailable.description: Billing is managed by the business owner and admins.

noSubscription.title: No subscription yet
noSubscription.description: Pick a plan to get your AI receptionist answering.

suspended.title: Service suspended — payment required
suspended.failedCharge: A charge of {amount} couldn't be collected.
suspended.body: Inbound calls play a service-paused message and outbound calling is blocked. Updating your card retries the charge immediately and restores service as soon as it succeeds. Phone numbers are released after 30 days of suspension.

pastDue.title: Payment failed
pastDue.failedCharge: We couldn't charge {amount} to your card.
pastDue.body: Service continues for now, but repeated failures lead to suspension. Updating your card retries the charge right away.

pending.title: Add a card to activate your subscription
pending.body: Your first charge runs — and your AI starts answering — the moment a card is saved.

cancellation.title: Cancellation scheduled
cancellation.body: Your subscription ends on {date}. Service continues until then.
cancellation.bodyNoDate: Your subscription ends on the current period's end. Service continues until then.

planChange.title: Plan change scheduled
planChange.body: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on {date}. To keep your current plan instead, pick it again on the <link>plans page</link>.
planChange.bodyNoDate: Your plan changes to {plan} ({interval, select, monthly {monthly} other {annual}}) on the next renewal. To keep your current plan instead, pick it again on the <link>plans page</link>.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel your subscription?
cancelDialog.pending: This ends your subscription setup. Nothing has been charged, and you can start again any time.
cancelDialog.suspended: Service is already paused; cancelling ends the subscription immediately. Any outstanding balance remains payable.
cancelDialog.active: Your subscription stays active until {date}. After that the AI stops answering calls and the portal locks until you resubscribe. You can resume any time before then.
cancelDialog.activeNoDate: Your subscription stays active until the end of the current period. After that the AI stops answering calls and the portal locks until you resubscribe. You can resume any time before then.

toasts.cancelScheduled: Cancellation scheduled for the end of the period.

currentPlan.priceLine: {price}/{interval, select, monthly {month} other {year}} + VAT · {interval, select, monthly {Monthly billing} other {Annual billing}}

paymentMethod.title: Payment method
paymentMethod.description: Charged for renewals, usage and plan changes. Card details are held by Stripe — never on our servers.
paymentMethod.retryNote: Saving a new card immediately retries the failed charge.

usage.title: Usage this period
usage.description: {start} – {end}. Usage charges are billed in arrears with each monthly renewal.
usage.over: {minutes} min over — billed at {rate}/min with the next renewal. Service is never cut for usage.
usage.overageRate: Overage past this allowance bills at {rate}/min.
usage.outboundNote: Pay as you go at {rate}/min — no included allowance.
usage.includedNumbers: {count, plural, one {# number is} other {# numbers are}} included with your plan; each extra bills at {rate}/month.

charges.description: Every subscription charge, with its full tax-invoice breakdown. Amounts in ILS (₪).
